description: Exports the open Marp .md to a vector PDF printed in chunks so that large decks do not fail (📄 button), or presents it full screen in Chrome (▶ button). A local extension that only calls the Node scripts under tools/ (macOS and Windows; not from the Marketplace; no dependencies).
command.present: Marp: Present This Deck in Chrome (Full Screen)
config.title: Marp GUI PDF
config.chunkSize: Pages printed per chunk. 0 uses the script default (20). If PDF export fails, use a smaller value such as 12.
config.chromePath: Path to the Chrome/Edge executable. Empty = auto-detect the standard install location for the OS (macOS: /Applications, Windows: Program Files). User settings only: a folder's own settings cannot change it.
config.nodePath: Path to the node executable. Empty = search PATH (set it only when node cannot be found, e.g. with nvm). User settings only: a folder's own settings cannot change it.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Runs the Node scripts under tools/ of the opened folder, so it works only in folders you trust.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Runs local Node scripts, so it does not work on virtual file systems.
